description:
Lawful development: Proposed use.
The proposed development relates to alterations and extensions to an existing dwellinghouse at 66 Graham Road, London, N15 3NJ. The works comprise a loft conversion including the construction of a rear dormer extension and the installation of two rooflights to the front roof slope.

The development is considered to be permitted development in accordance with Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended). The proposed extension is located on the rear roof slope and does not exceed the height of the existing roof. The materials will match the appearance of the existing dwelling, and the rooflights will be installed flush with the roof slope.

The property is an existing single dwellinghouse (Use Class C3) and the proposal does not involve any change of use. The development therefore complies with the relevant limitations and conditions of Class B permitted development rights.
